LeXia

LeXia uses the TMDB API for movie and TV metadata, artwork, trailers, cast, production details, collections, and recommendations. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
LeXia connects to Trakt for account authentication, watched history, progress sync, library data, ratings, lists, and comments. LeXia is not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.

LeXia connects to Simkl for account authentication, watchlists, watched history, playback progress, and scrobbling. Movie, TV, and anime tracking data is provided by Simkl. LeXia is not affiliated with or endorsed by Simkl.
LeXia connects to Premiumize for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. LeXia is not affiliated with or endorsed by Premiumize.
LeXia connects to TorBox for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. LeXia is not affiliated with or endorsed by TorBox.
LeXia uses MDBList for ratings, watched history and playback tracking. LeXia is not affiliated with or endorsed by MDBList.
LeXia uses the IntroDB API for community-provided intro, recap, credits, and preview timestamps used by skip controls. LeXia is not affiliated with or endorsed by IntroDB.

LeXia uses IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets, including title.ratings.tsv.gz, for IMDb ratings and vote counts. Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission. IMDb data is for personal and non-commercial use under IMDb terms.
